conceptBlocks.text: 同期群是按共同起点划分的一组客户，本题起点为历史首购月份。

items: 第0月为首购月；第1月为下一自然月，不是首购后30天。

conceptBlocks.text: 每期留存率=该同期群当月购买的去重客户数÷首购群原始人数。

items: 各月分别计算，因此不要求连续活跃，客户中途不买后再次购买仍可计入当月留存。

syntax.purpose: 客户留存与同期群分析的语法模板如下，各部分含义见下方说明。

problem: 线上有效订单，历史首购月份确定同期群；观察截止2025-12-31，月偏移0至6。一同期群×月偏移一行。已观察而无购买记0，未来未观察月份不展示；分母沿用同期群初始人数。

methodBlocks.text: a 用 MIN 得首购月份，b 按同期群数客户；m 从日历抽取完整月份；x 将同期群与月份交叉连接，仅保留不早于首购且不晚于截止月的组合，月偏移=年份差×12+月份差。
y 将订单连接首购群，再按群和月去重客户。最终用 x 左连接 y，缺交易且已观察的月份填0。原生数据库转换整数用 SIGNED，本地示例用 INTEGER。

breakdown.title: 确定客户首购月份
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 确定客户首购月份（a）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 统计同期群初始人数
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 统计同期群初始人数（b）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 建立日期维度月份
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31')
SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 建立日期维度月份（m）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 生成同期群观察月份及月偏移
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort)
SELECT * FROM x ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 生成同期群观察月份及月偏移（x）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 统计各期活跃客户
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS INTEGER))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS INTEGER)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS INTEGER) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort), y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7))
SELECT * FROM y ORDER BY 1, 2, 3 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 统计各期活跃客户（y）的实际执行结果。

completeCode.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(SUBSTR(order_date,1,7)) cohort FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' GROUP BY customer_id), b AS (SELECT cohort,COUNT(*) n FROM a GROUP BY cohort), m AS (SELECT DISTINCT month_key FROM calendar_days WHERE day<='2025-12-31'), x AS (SELECT b.cohort,m.month_key,b.n,(CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,1,4) AS SIGNED)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,1,4) AS SIGNED))*12+CAST(SUBSTR(m.month_key,6,2) AS SIGNED)-CAST(SUBSTR(b.cohort,6,2) AS SIGNED) k FROM b CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.month_key>=b.cohort), y AS (SELECT a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7) m,COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) active FROM a JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=a.customer_id AND o.channel='online' GROUP BY a.cohort,SUBSTR(o.order_date,1,7)) SELECT x.cohort,x.k month_offset,x.n cohort_size,COALESCE(y.active,0) active_customers,ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(y.active,0)/x.n,2) retention_pct FROM x LEFT JOIN y ON y.cohort=x.cohort AND y.m=x.month_key WHERE x.k BETWEEN 0 AND 6 ORDER BY x.cohort,x.k

resultBlocks.text: 9月首购群2人，10月客户1有两笔订单但只算1人，次月留存50%；11月0%，12月客户1回来为50%，说明本口径不是连续留存。12月群在样例中只有第0月，不能填未来月份0%。
原企业2023年1月群7人，次月4人留存57.14%，第三个观察月2人28.57%；不同群应比较相同偏移并确认观察窗口。
